s: Dine tzitzit beshabbat ubo t' seipim: arbaat hatztzitzit mitzva achat hen, ulepikak hen meakkebot zo et zo, shekkol zeman sheen battallit kol had' tzitzit — enah metzuyyetzet kehilkatah, vehayyotze bah beshabbat lirshut harabbim — chayyab chattat, lepi shehatztzitzit hatteluyim bah en bahem mitzva vahare hem kemashoy. Veap-al-pi shehen mechubbarin lattallit — enan betelim legabbe hattallit, mippene shehem chashubim beenayv vedato alehem ad sheyyashlim kol had' tzitzit. Vaapillu nipselu kol had' tzitzit al yede pesiqat hachutin shello nishtayyer bahem kede aniba — ap-al-pi-ken otan hachutin shennishtayyeru shelemim shello nipsequ adayin hem chashubim beenayv vedato lehosip alehem od chutin acherim, velaken ap-al-pi shemmechubbarim lattallit — enan betelim legabbe hattallit vahare hem kemashoy, kevan sheakshav hem pesulim enan lo minnoy hattallit velo mittashmishe hattallit, shehare en lattallit tzorek bahem kelal. Abal im nipsequ kol hachutin shebbekol had' tzitzit velo nishar bahem apillu chut echad arok sheyyihyeh shalem uqetzat mehem nipsequ velo nishtayyeru bahem kede aniba beinyan shekkol hatztzitzit hem pesulim veen lahem taqqana ella hu tzarik laasot tzitzit acherim tachtehem, lepikak en ellu chutin happesuqim chashubin beenayv liklum laken betelin hen legabbe hattallit, ulepikak muttar latzet bahem apillu lirshut harabbim im hi tallit [sheula] sheenah chayyebet betzitzit, deim lo ken hare asur lehitlabbesh betallit sheyyesh bo d' kenapot belo tzitzit kemo shennitbaer siman ch:

Tallit shehi metzuyyetzet kehilkatah — muttar latzet bah lirshut harabbim apillu bizman hazzeh sheen lanu tekelet, ben hattallit qatan ben hattallit gadol, ben bayyom ben ballayla, veap-al-pi shellayla lav zeman tzitzit hu, mippene shehatztzitzit hakkesherim hem minnoy habbeged vetakshitayv kemo haimra vekayyotze bah, lepikak en zeh kemashoy. Raq yizzaher shello tehe hattallit munnachat lo al ketepo shello kederek lebishatah bechol, kemo shennitbaer siman sha saip l[h] ayyen sham:
En tzarik libdoq et hatztzitzit keshehu yotze lirshut harabbim im kebar bodqum beoto hayyom, mippene shemmaamidin otan bechezqatan, kemo shennitbaer besiman ch ayyen sham:

Im noda lo beshabbat keshehu omed birshut harabbim shehattallit shealayv hu pasul min hattora — tzarik leposhto, ben tallit qatan ben tallit gadol, vaapillu yishshaer omed arom bashshuq, sheen kebod habberiyyot docheh et lo taaseh shebbattora, shenneemar: "en chokma veen tebuna veen etza leneged Hashem" (veayyen beyoreh dea siman shag vehu haddin kan). Abal im haya bechol, im hu tallit qatan — en tzarik leposhto, veap-al-pi shehu mebattel mitzvat aseh shel tora bemah shehu labush d' kenapot belo tzitzit, mikkol maqom kevan shehu eno oseh maaseh beyadayim ella haaseh hi nidchet mimmela — gadol kebod habberiyyot vedocheh et issur shel tora besheb veal taaseh. Umikkol maqom tzarik lemaher velelek lebeto lehapshito mealayv, apillu hu oseq bidbar mitzva kegon shehu bebet hakkeneset o bebet hammidrash, kevan shehu issur shel tora. Abal betallit gadol shellanu kevan sheen lobeshin oto leshem malbush ella leshem mitzva, im ken en genay behapshatato, velaken tzarik leposhto apillu bashshuq:

Haholek lebet hakkeneset umatza shennipsela tallito, ap-al-pi shemmitbayyesh lehitpallel belo tallit — asur lo lehitlabbesh betallito apillu belo beraka, kevan sheen kan genay gadol lesheb belo tallit — en dochi[yan] aseh shel tora mippene genay qatan:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechol, kevan shehu yakol lehatil tzitzit betallito, im ken keshellobesho — ober al qum vaaseh. Abal beshabbat, kevan shee[no] yakol lehatil tzitzit mechamat issur shabbat — en issur min hattora lilbosh tallit belo tzitzit, shehare lo omra tora: lo tilbash beged belo tzitzit, ella leachar sheyyilbeshennu mitzvat aseh lehatil bo tzitzit, vekevan sheeno yakol lehatil — eno ober. Ella demikkol maqom midderabbanan asur lelobsho, kevan shessopo lebattel mitzvat aseh, vachakamim lo heemidu dibrehem bimqom kebod habberiyyot, apillu en sham ella genay qatan, laken im hu mitbayyesh [lehitpallel] belo tallit — yakol lelobsho belo beraka:
Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello yada qodem shabbat shennipsela tallito, abal im yada bo qodem shabbat — asur lelobsho beshabbat, dehaya lo letaqqen meetmol:

Im noda lo beshabbat keshehu bekarmelit sheen issuro ella midderabbanan shehattallit shealayv pasul — en tzarik leposhto, delo heemidu dibrehem bimqom kebod habberiyyot. Vaapillu betallitot shellanu sheenam ella leshem mitzva veenam genay behapshatatan, mikkol maqom kevan sheen kan ella issur midderabbanan kemo shebbearnu, demin hattora muttar lehitlabbesh betallit belo tzitzit beshabbat, vekevan shello gazeru lehapshit et hattallit bekarmelit — lo ratzu lechalleq ben tallit letallit, veeno tzarik lipshot mealayv shum beged bekarmelit:

Haroeh bachabero shennipselu lo tzitziyyotayv, im hu bemaqom sheyyitztarek leposhto mealayv — lo yomar lo ad sheyyabo lebeto, demishshum kebod habberiyyot lo yaprishennu meissur shogeg. Umikkol maqom tzarik hu liqro lo sheyyabo lebeto bimhera vesham yomar lo sheyyapshitennu mealayv. Vehu haddin im hu bemaqom sheen tzarik leposhto mealayv raq beinyan shetztzarik lemaher velelek lebeto leposhto mealayv veal derek shennitbaer lemala — tzarik haroeh lomar lo sheyyelek lebeto bimhera vesham yapshitennu mealayv:
